stemMd: A quadratic function has zeros 2 and 8 and passes through $(0,32)$. What is its value at $x=5$?
explanationMd: Write f(x)=a(x−2)(x−8). The point (0,32) gives 16a=32, so a=2. Then f(5)=2(3)(−3)=−18. The midpoint of the roots is also the vertex x-coordinate.
